## Sources (read 2026-11-24)

- Meta Ads Guide, per format and placement: `facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/{image|video|carousel}/{facebook-feed|facebook-story|facebook-facebook-reels|facebook-marketplace|facebook-video-feeds|facebook-instream-video|facebook-right-hand-column|facebook-search|instagram-feed|instagram-story|instagram-reels|instagram-explore-home}`
- Supported ratios per placement: facebook.com/business/help/682655495435254
- Safe zones: facebook.com/business/help/980593475366490
- Ratio best practices and automatic padding: /business/help/103816146375741, /business/help/1530327025203003
- Placement list: /business/help/407108559393196
- CTA labels: /business/help/410873986524407; CTA enum: Marketing API v27 `ad-creative-link-data-call-to-action`
- IG crop rules: Marketing API Instagram media requirements

## Verified vs assumed

**From Meta's documentation:** formats per placement; supported and recommended ratios; recommended character counts; Stories/Reels safe zone (top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6%); desktop FB Feed shows video at 1:1 with side bars; IG Feed crops images taller than 4:5 / wider than 1.91:1; CTA labels.

**Assumptions in the renderer (flagged as "simulated" in mockups):**
- *Pad* outside the supported range on Facebook placements (Feed, Video Feeds, Search, Marketplace, Right Column): Meta documents automatic padding, and on 2026-11-25 the Ad Library preview of a real advertiser's 9:16-only ad showed the whole image with gray side bars rather than a crop. The renderer frames the media at the nearest supported ratio and pads with gray. The exact frame ratio and bar colour inside the phone app are not verified.
- Description on mobile FB Feed and Video Feeds: shown, up to 2 lines. Changed 2026-11-25 after the Ad Library preview showed it (the Ads Guide lists no description for single-image feed ads).
- Stories and Reels carousels: the viewer shows one card at a time (card 1 by default); `export_png.py --all-cards` exports each card.
- *Fill* in Stories and Reels: Meta says it pads non-9:16 media automatically but doesn't document the padding style. The mockup uses a blurred, darkened copy of the media.
- Primary text shown above padded media in Stories: commonly observed, not documented.
- Line-based truncation (3 lines on FB Feed, 2 on IG Feed and Reels): Meta documents no truncation rule; secondary sources (2026) give ~125 chars for feeds, 40–72 for Reels. Real truncation varies by device and font.
- IG Feed shows 9:16 video at full height (Meta lists 9:16 as supported and applies Reels safe zones to it).
- IG Explore (opened post) and IG Profile Feed have no Ads Guide pages; they inherit IG Feed rules.
- FB Video Feeds no longer appears in Meta's current placement list (still accepted by the API). Kept for completeness; rules copied from FB Feed.
- FB In-stream is rendered as the classic 16:9 player with the ad playing in it. Meta now calls the placement "Facebook in-stream reels".
- Mobile FB Feed hides the link area (headline, description, CTA) under the Awareness objective and some engagement goals. The mockup always shows it.

**Known conflicts in Meta's own pages:** Right Column recommended ratio (1:1 in the Ads Guide vs 1.91:1 in the Help Center; 1:1 used); IG Feed image recommendation (4:5 vs 1:1; 4:5 used); FB Stories carousel bottom safe zone (20% in an older note vs 35%; 35% used); BOOK_TRAVEL label ("Book travel" used).

## Fidelity notes

- Default device: iPhone-width (393 pt) with an iOS status bar; system fonts (on Windows this renders in Segoe UI, not SF Pro, so text is slightly wider than on an iPhone).
- UI chrome is drawn with hand-made SVG/CSS approximations of the current apps. No Meta asset files are used.
- Instagram chrome (updated 2026-11-25) follows the 2026 app as described in public coverage:
  - Header: "+" (Create) left, wordmark centered, notifications heart right. The August 2026 sans-serif wordmark is approximated with a geometric system font (Century Gothic / Avenir / Futura).
  - Bottom bar: floating translucent "Liquid Glass" pill in the order Home · Reels · Messages · Search · Profile (rolled out in waves through 2026; some accounts may still have the old bar).
  - Post action row: counts inline next to heart, comment and share, plus a repost icon, with no separate "likes" line. *Unverified against a phone screenshot.*
  - Wordmark centering and the exact pill size and colour are also unverified. A phone screenshot of a real Instagram ad is the best way to tighten these.
- Emoji render with the local OS emoji font.
- Sources for the Instagram chrome: [Fast Company on the new wordmark](https://www.fastcompany.com/91589846/instagram-has-a-new-wordmark), [GB News on the Liquid Glass tab bar](https://www.gbnews.com/tech/instagram-ios-liquid-glass-update), [Dataconomy on the Reels/DMs tab order](https://dataconomy.com/2025/10/13/instagram-tests-reels-first-redesign-with-dms-at-the-center/), [Storrito on the 2026 rollout](https://storrito.com/resources/what-instagrams-navigation-redesign-actually-changed/).

## Maintenance

When Meta changes specs or the apps change:
1. Update `assets/placements.json` (bump `version_date`).
2. Run `python scripts/sync_spec.py` to regenerate the tables in `SPEC.md` and here.
3. For UI changes, edit the template functions (`T.*`) and CSS in `assets/viewer.html`; compare a PNG export against a fresh phone screenshot of a real ad.
